chunks: O you who believe, do not practice usury, charging doubled and redoubled (interest); but have fear of God: you may well attain your goal.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quranic ruling on usury and compound interest?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to distinguish between minor and major riba, with the 'doubled and redoubled' phrase emphasizing the exponential growth of debt that leads to economic injustice. It underscores the principle that true success (falah) is contingent upon taqwa, linking spiritual piety directly to ethical financial conduct. This commandment serves as a foundational prohibition against exploitative lending practices that burden the poor.
